9//! `svgwriter` is a typed library for writing correct SVG files. It includes SVG
10//! specification and documentation from [mdn](https://developer.mozilla.org).
11//!
12//! ## Example
13//!
14//! ```rust
15//! # use std::fmt::Write as _;
16//! use svgwriter::{
17//! 	tags::{Path, TagWithPresentationAttributes as _},
18//! 	Data, Graphic
19//! };
20//!
21//! let mut svg = Graphic::new();
22//! let size = 100;
23//! svg.set_width(size);
24//! svg.set_height(size);
25//! svg.set_view_box(format!("0 0 {size} {size}"));
26//!
27//! // draw a heart, inspired by https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/SVG/Attribute/d#example
28//! let d = 40;
29//! let padding = size / 2 - d;
30//! let mut heart = Data::new();
31//! heart
32//! 	.move_to(padding, padding + d / 2)
33//! 	.arc_by(d / 2, d / 2, 0, false, true, d, 0)
34//! 	.arc_by(d / 2, d / 2, 0, false, true, d, 0)
35//! 	.quad_by(0, d * 3 / 4, -d, d * 3 / 2)
36//! 	.quad_by(-d,-d * 3 / 4, -d, -d * 3 / 2);
37//! svg.push(
38//! 	Path::new()
39//! 		.with_d(heart)
40//! 		.with_fill("#A919FA")
41//! 		.with_fill_opacity(0.5)
42//! 		.with_stroke("#A919FA")
43//! 		.with_stroke_width(3)
44//! );
45//!
46//! // write the svg to a file
47//! # let mut file = String::new();
48//! write!(file, "{}", svg.to_string());
49//! # assert_eq!(file, "<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' xmlns:xlink='http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink' width='100' height='100' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><path d='M10,30a20,20,0,0,1,40,0a20,20,0,0,1,40,0q0,30,-40,60q-40,-30,-40,-60' fill='#A919FA' fill-opacity='0.5' stroke='#A919FA' stroke-width='3'/></svg>");
50//! ```
51//!
52//! This code produces the following image:
53//!
54//! <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' xmlns:xlink='http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink' width='100' height='100' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><path d='M10,30a20,20,0,0,1,40,0a20,20,0,0,1,40,0q0,30,-40,60q-40,-30,-40,-60' fill='#A919FA' fill-opacity='0.5' stroke='#A919FA' stroke-width='3'/></svg>
55//!
56//! ![Image produced by example code](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20xmlns:xlink='http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink'%20width='100'%20height='100'%20viewBox='0%200%20100%20100'%3E%3Cpath%20d='M10,30a20,20,0,0,1,40,0a20,20,0,0,1,40,0q0,30,-40,60q-40,-30,-40,-60'%20fill='%23A919FA'%20fill-opacity='0.5'%20stroke='%23A919FA'%20stroke-width='3'/%3E%3C/svg%3E)
